nodes.description: Public flag controlling whether tickets can be bought; read by buyTickets/closeLotteryAndPickWinner, written by openLottery/setMaxTokenBuyin.
Contract owner address, set from msg.sender in the constructor, gates onlyOwner functions.
POWM token contract instance (external contract) used for buy/transfer/myTokens.
Referrer address passed to maths.buy; set to msg.sender in constructor and overwritten with the lottery winner.
Mapping from ticket index to gambler address; source of the winner address.
Number of tickets in the current round; also used as the modulus for winner selection.
Round counter, initialised to 1, incremented in openLottery.
Mapping of address to tokens bought in the current round.
Mapping of address to the round in which it last bought, used as a per-round guard.
Cached amount of POWM tokens held by the lottery.
Owner-configurable maximum number of tickets per buy-in.
Hard-coded POWM token contract address used by maths.
Payable fallback; forwards calls from non-POWM addresses to buyTickets and receives dividends.
Public payable ticket purchase: buys POWM tokens, records gamblers entries and buy-in stats.
Owner-only: closes the lottery, picks a pseudo-random winner and sends tokens plus all ETH to it.
Public payable donation that converts ETH into POWM tokens held by the lottery.
Owner-only: increments current_round, opens the lottery and resets the ticket counter.
Owner-only: changes MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN while the lottery is closed.
Constructor: sets current_round, owner and masternode_referrer from msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, gambler entries, buy-ins and the fallback check.
Miner-influenceable block data (block.number/block.blockhash, timestamp-class) used as pseudo-randomness for winner selection.
maths.buy.value(msg.value)(masternode_referrer) external call inside buyTickets before any accounting.
maths.transfer(winner, exact_tokens) external ERC20 call whose boolean return value is never checked.
winner.transfer(address(this).balance) sends the entire ETH balance to an attacker-controlled address.
uint256(keccak256(block.blockhash(block.number - 1))) % num_tickets_current_round: miner-influenceable pseudo-randomness and possible modulus by zero.
while (i < tokens_bought) ticket loop using a uint8 counter i against a uint256 bound; wraps at 256 and can loop forever.
maths.buy.value(msg.value)(masternode_referrer) external call inside donateToLottery.
maths.myTokens() snapshot taken before the buy in buyTickets.
maths.myTokens() snapshot taken after the buy in buyTickets.
Tokens bought in buyTickets (SafeMath.sub(after, before).div(1e18)), drives the ticket loop and is bounded by MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN.
uint8 loop counter incrementing the ticket insertion loop in buyTickets.
maths.myTokens() snapshot before the buy in donateToLottery.
maths.myTokens() snapshot after the buy in donateToLottery.
Index computed from block data modulo num_tickets_current_round in closeLotteryAndPickWinner.
Winner address read from gamblers[winning_number]; receives tokens and the whole ETH balance.
maths.myTokens() amount transferred to the winner in closeLotteryAndPickWinner.
New maximum buy-in value supplied to setMaxTokenBuyin.

edges.reason: Constructor consumes msg.sender to initialise owner and masternode_referrer.
owner is assigned directly from msg.sender with no ownership transfer or validation logic.
masternode_referrer is initialised from msg.sender and later replaced by the winner.
msg.sender determines the buy-in accounting and becomes the gambler entry.
Fallback compares msg.sender with the POWM token address before forwarding to buyTickets.
Any caller can invoke donateToLottery with msg.value.
Winner is read from gamblers, a mapping populated by untrusted msg.sender.
The attacker-controlled winner address receives the full contract balance via a low-level transfer.
masternode_referrer is overwritten with the winner address.
winning_number is produced from block data modulo the ticket count.
winning_number indexes the gamblers mapping to obtain the winner.
Miner-influenceable block data (block.number/block.blockhash) is used as pseudo-randomness for winner selection.
Modulus operand num_tickets_current_round can be zero, reverting on division by zero.
num_tickets_current_round is the write index into gamblers.
num_tickets_current_round is incremented once per ticket inside buyTickets.
tokens_bought determines how many gambler entries are written.
The maths token contract instance is the target of the buy external call.
The maths token contract instance is the target of the transfer external call.
The maths token contract instance is the target of the donateToLottery buy call.
numTokensInLottery is refreshed from maths.myTokens() after the buy.
numTokensInLottery is refreshed from maths.myTokens() in donateToLottery.
uint256 tokens_bought is compared with the uint8 loop counter as the loop bound.
uint8 counter i wraps to 0 after 255 iterations, so a buy-in above 255 loops forever.
The loop writes gamblers entries indexed by num_tickets_current_round.
tokens_bought is required to be <= MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN.
Owner-settable MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN can exceed the uint8 counter range, breaking the ticket loop invariant.
last_round_bought[msg.sender] != current_round guards buyTickets against repeat buys in a round.
current_round is stored into last_round_bought[msg.sender] at the end of buyTickets.
current_round is the value written into the last_round_bought mapping.
openLottery increments current_round.
token_buyins[msg.sender] is set to tokens_bought.
buyTickets refreshes numTokensInLottery after purchasing tokens.
require(isLotteryOpen == true) gates ticket purchases.
closeLotteryAndPickWinner requires the lottery to be open and then closes it.
setMaxTokenBuyin requires the lottery to be closed.
openLottery sets isLotteryOpen to true.
onlyOwner modifier restricts setMaxTokenBuyin to the recorded owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts openLottery to the recorded owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts closeLotteryAndPickWinner to the recorded owner.
The payable fallback forwards non-POWM callers to buyTickets.
buyTickets executes the maths.buy external call.
donateToLottery executes the maths.buy external call.
closeLotteryAndPickWinner computes the weak pseudo-random winning number.
Onwer-only close function sends the entire ETH balance to the winner address, enabling re-entry into the contract.
closeLotteryAndPickWinner calls maths.transfer and ignores its boolean return value.
MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN is overwritten by the owner-controlled setter.
The tokens parameter becomes the new MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN value.
donateToLottery caches maths.myTokens() into numTokensInLottery.
exact_tokens is the amount passed to maths.transfer for the winner.
tokens_before is the minuend of the token delta computation.
tokens_after is subtracted by tokens_before to obtain tokens_bought.
The donated amount is computed as tokens_after - tokens_before.
buyTickets runs the uint8-indexed ticket insertion loop.
The low-level ETH transfer to the winner can re-enter the payable fallback before the function completes.
If the winner is a contract, the unchecked ERC20 transfer can call back into the lottery's payable fallback.

normalization_plan.reason: Temporary snapshot local only used to compute the token delta inside buyTickets; merge into the enclosing function node.
Temporary snapshot local subordinate to the buyTickets accounting flow; merge into the enclosing function node.
Drives the ticket loop and its uint8/uint256 comparison, so it folds into the loop's unsafe_operation node.
uint8 loop counter whose wraparound is the core of the arithmetic unsafe operation.
Temporary snapshot local used only for the donated-token delta in donateToLottery.
Temporary snapshot local subordinate to donateToLottery's return computation.
Direct result of the block-data modulo expression, folding into the weak-randomness unsafe operation.
Winner address exists only to receive the balance transfer, so it folds into that unsafe_operation.
Token amount exists only as the argument of maths.transfer, so it folds into that unsafe_operation.
Single input parameter written straight into MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN by its enclosing function.
